historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; copies the source typo into a literal filter and would likely produce empty evidence while exposing command credentials and suppressing errors.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; resolves canonical Asset Tag and protected handling but misclassifies capability.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; treats the typo-bearing command as runnable without correcting the field or protecting the value.

original_test_intent: Verify the canonical Asset Tag of the intended SMBIOS Type 3 enclosure equals the protected chassis asset inventory and persists after reboot; `Asset Tage` is an editorial error, not a separate field.
original_method: Capture complete Type 3 records directly into protected storage, bind the intended enclosure by serial/type/BOM context, parse canonical Asset Tag, compare with the authorized chassis asset reference, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the typo correction, protected asset reference, enclosure mapping and reboot plan. Secure extraction and comparison remain software-controlled.
required_inputs: Approved source-label to canonical Asset Tag mapping
Protected evidence/redaction policy and validated dmidecode/transport
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and write raw Type 3 evidence only to approved protected storage.
Do not use literal `Asset Tage` grep as authoritative and do not expose the tag in chat or general logs.
Do not substitute Type 1 or Type 2 asset data and do not assume the first Type 3 record.
Reject blank, placeholder, duplicate and wrong-enclosure tags.
Stop on exposure, ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect protected all-Type-3 evidence, normalize only the label typo, select the enclosure and compare its canonical Asset Tag before/after reboot with redacted reporting.
Do not modify DMI, disclose asset values or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve canonical-field mapping, enclosure identity, protected asset reference and evidence rules.
Resolve asset ownership/provisioning discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not directly applicable because the misspelled literal is not the canonical decoded field; inline output also risks data exposure, hides errors and lacks enclosure provenance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the typo as source provenance, use approved authenticated transport/protected storage, archive full Type 3 output and parse canonical Asset Tag only from the mapped enclosure record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact `Asset Tage` label, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained verbatim.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Normalize the source label to canonical Asset Tag for extraction only, keep the raw source unchanged, compare the selected Type 3 record to protected inventory inside the evidence boundary and export only redacted status/provenance.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, chassis and inventory revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable Type 3 field semantics, approved asset/evidence policy and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects the extraction key, adds enclosure identity and prevents sensitive tag disclosure.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Canonical mapping, protected tag and enclosure identity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An inventory match does not independently prove the physical label unless another authorized inspection covers it.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a format, supported absence or separate physical-label comparison, but must retain canonical mapping, exact enclosure identity and protected raw evidence.
expected_evidence: Approval, typo mapping, protected asset reference, enclosure/BOM mapping and tool version
Protected raw pre-reboot Type 3 plus redacted target-tag comparison
Protected raw post-reboot same-enclosure tag comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 3 context and canonical field make `Asset Tage` an unambiguous spelling error; there is no competing behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The canonical field is identifiable and safely queryable; protected reference and storage are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its typo-literal grep and exposed output while preserving the Type 3 read intent.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps canonical mapping and protected handling but corrects capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds explicit source preservation, enclosure selection and separation from any physical-label inspection.

review_improvement: Avoids guaranteed empty evidence, wrong-record acceptance and disclosure of a sensitive chassis asset identifier.
independent_technical_reasoning: After approval of the mapping and protected inputs, all core collection and comparison steps are automated; a corrected field label does not require human execution.
